title: About DarGlobal PLC - International Luxury Real Estate Developer
text: DarGlobal PLC is an elite international luxury real estate development company listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE: DAR). Founded in 2017 as the global arm of Dar Al Arkan (a titan in Middle Eastern real estate with over 30 years of development heritage), DarGlobal is dedicated to delivering bespoke vacation homes and prime luxury urban residences for discerning international high-net-worth individuals. The company operates in leading global hubs across the United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Sultanate of Oman, Qatar, Spain, and Bosnia.

title: DarGlobal Investor Relations - LSE Listing and Financial Highlights
text: DarGlobal PLC is traded on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol DAR. The company commands a Gross Development Value (GDV) surpassing $5.9 billion across multiple active international projects. DarGlobal operates an asset-light, capital-efficient operational model, co-investing with tier-one master developers, financial institutions, and sovereign entities (such as Omran in Oman and Qetaifan Projects in Qatar). The business focuses on markets that provide robust legal protections, strong currency stability, favorable tax environments, and residency through investment.

title: DarGlobal Brand Partnerships - Automotive, Fashion & Hospitality
text: A key strategic differentiator for DarGlobal is co-branding with world-renowned luxury brands. In automotive design, DarGlobal collaborates with Automobili Lamborghini for luxury villas in Spain and Pagani Automobili for hypercar-inspired skyscraper architecture in Dubai. In fashion and haute couture, partnerships include Missoni for waterfront interiors and Elie Saab for beachfront branded residences. In hospitality and leisure, DarGlobal partners with Marriott International for W Residences Downtown Dubai and The Trump Organization for luxury golf resorts and cliffside estates in Oman.

title: Contact DarGlobal - Global Sales Galleries and Headquarters
text: DarGlobal maintains sales galleries and executive offices across major financial capitals. Corporate headquarters are located in London, United Kingdom, with regional flagship galleries in Dubai (Downtown & Business Bay), Riyadh (Saudi Arabia), Marbella (Spain), and Muscat (Oman). International buyers can book private virtual tours, schedule in-person consultations, and access multilingual portfolio advisors via email at info@darglobal.co.uk or by phone at +971 4 247 8999 (Dubai) and +44 20 7355 8300 (London).

title: DarGlobal Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Purchasing, Payment Plans & Golden Visa
text: FAQ: Can foreign nationals purchase freehold property with DarGlobal? Yes, all DarGlobal projects in Dubai, Oman, Qatar, Spain, and the UK offer 100% foreign freehold ownership. Payment plans are typically construction-linked (e.g., 20% down payment, 50% staggered during construction milestones, and 30% upon completion/handover). Qualifying property purchases above AED 2,000,000 in Dubai qualify foreign buyers for the 10-year UAE Golden Visa, while investments exceeding €500,000 in Spain qualify for the Spanish Golden Visa residency permit.

title: DarGlobal Financial Results and Revenue Growth
text: DarGlobal reports robust financial performance underpinned by strong international pre-sales across Dubai, Oman, and Spain. International buyers originate primarily from Europe, the GCC, the United Kingdom, and the Americas. Operating margins are sustained through disciplined cost engineering and strategic land acquisitions, with revenue recognized under IFRS 15 percentage-of-completion principles. The company maintains negligible net debt, providing strong balance sheet resilience.

title: Urban Oasis by Missoni - Luxury Waterfront Living on Dubai Canal
text: Urban Oasis by Missoni is a prestigious 34-storey residential tower developed by DarGlobal, positioned directly on the Dubai Water Canal in Business Bay. Featuring interior design exclusively curated by the Italian fashion powerhouse Missoni, the tower offers studios, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, 3-bedroom canal apartments, and ultra-exclusive 4-bedroom penthouses with private elevator entrances. The architectural design maximizes panoramic canal and downtown skyline vistas. Amenities include an infinity-edge swimming pool, state-of-the-art gym, landscaped podium gardens, 24/7 concierge, and direct boardwalk access.

title: DaVinci Tower by Pagani - Hypercar Luxury Residences, Downtown Dubai Canal
text: DaVinci Tower (Pagani Tower) is DarGlobal's signature ultra-luxury skyscraper located in Downtown Dubai on the Dubai Canal, created in exclusive partnership with Pagani Automobili. Drawing engineering and aesthetic cues from Horacio Pagani's legendary hypercars (the Zonda and Huayra), the tower incorporates exposed carbon-fiber accents, kinetic light sculptures, bespoke Italian leather craftsmanship, and aerodynamic geometry. The residences include 2 to 4-bedroom apartments and a crown duplex penthouse with private rooftop plunge pools, spa suites, 24/7 white-glove concierge, and unobstructed views of Burj Khalifa.

title: W Residences Dubai - Downtown - Branded Hospitality Living
text: W Residences Dubai - Downtown is a 49-storey architectural statement developed by DarGlobal and operated under the W Hotels brand by Marriott International. Located minutes from Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa, the tower comprises 384 branded luxury residences. Resident privileges include signature W 'Whatever/Whenever' lifestyle services, the Clubhouse private co-working lounge, screening media room, an infinity pool deck overlooking the downtown skyline, fully-equipped FIT fitness center, and VIP status privileges across the global Marriott Bonvoy luxury portfolio.

title: DG1 Living - Sculpted Architecture in Business Bay Waterfront, Dubai
text: DG1 Living is an architectural landmark created by DarGlobal on the banks of the Dubai Canal in Business Bay. Designed by globally acclaimed architecture firm Gensler, the tower features an eye-catching twisting facade that optimizes natural light and canal views. The development offers premium 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences equipped with European designer kitchens, high ceilings, floor-to-ceiling soundproof glass panels, sky gardens, infinity pool, fitness center, and a ground-level retail promenade.

title: Tabist Luxury Developments - Business Bay & Downtown Dubai
text: DarGlobal's urban developments in Dubai focus on prime canal-front and downtown locations. Every residence comes with dedicated covered parking, smart home climate integration, energy-efficient double-glazed facades, and bespoke interior packages. Proximity to DIFC (Dubai International Financial Centre) and Dubai International Airport (DXB) makes these developments highly attractive to international business executives and long-term rental investors.

title: AIDA - Seafront Master Development on the Ocean Cliffs of Muscat, Oman
text: AIDA is a transformative $4 billion oceanfront master development and gated community located 130 meters atop towering sea cliffs in Yiti and Yenkit, Muscat, Sultanate of Oman. Spanning over 3.5 million square meters, AIDA is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Omran (the executive arm of the Sultanate for tourism development). The masterplan features the Trump International Golf Club Oman (an 18-hole championship course), cliff-hanging luxury villas, luxury hotel resort, private beaches, Michelin-starred cliffside dining, wellness retreats, and 100% freehold ownership granting Omani investor residency.

title: Trump International Resort and Golf Club - AIDA, Muscat, Oman
text: Trump International Resort, Golf Club & Residences at AIDA represents an iconic collaboration between DarGlobal and The Trump Organization. Anchored by a world-class 18-hole championship golf course designed to international PGA standards, the resort includes elite Trump Cliff Villas, branded golf residences, an exclusive members-only clubhouse, signature Trump spa, infinity pools hanging over the Arabian Sea, and equestrian trails. Property buyers obtain immediate permanent residency rights in Oman for themselves and direct dependents.

title: Les Vagues by Elie Saab - Qetaifan Island North, Lusail, Qatar
text: Les Vagues by Elie Saab is the first branded waterfront residential project in Qatar by world-famous Lebanese fashion designer Elie Saab. Situated on Qetaifan Island North off Lusail, Les Vagues features bespoke 1, 2, and 3-bedroom seaside residences with expansive private terraces looking out across the Arabian Gulf. Designed with soft coastal curves and furnished with Elie Saab Maison haute couture aesthetics, the project includes private beach access, state-of-the-art fitness center, sea-view infinity pool, 24/7 concierge, and a private marina promenade.

title: Tierra Viva by Automobili Lamborghini - Benahavis, Costa del Sol, Spain
text: Tierra Viva is an exclusive gated enclave of 53 ultra-luxury architectural villas located in Benahavis, nestled in the hills of Marbella on Spain's Costa del Sol. Designed by DarGlobal in collaboration with Automobili Lamborghini, the villas feature dynamic angular lines and materials directly inspired by Italian supercars. The estate offers three villa typologies: Diamante (6 bedrooms), Zafiro (5 bedrooms), and Esmeralda (4 bedrooms). Each villa features private infinity swimming pools, rooftop solariums, home cinema rooms, wine cellars, and panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and Gibraltar.

title: Tierra Viva Lamborghini Villa Typologies - Diamante, Zafiro, Esmeralda
text: Tierra Viva villa specifications: The Diamante Villa spans 6 bedrooms over 4 levels with multi-car showcase garages, private spa, and sauna. The Zafiro Villa spans 5 bedrooms across 3 levels with expansive wrap-around infinity pools. The Esmeralda Villa offers 4 bedrooms with terrace gardens and open-plan gourmet kitchens. Built with reinforced concrete, floor-to-ceiling glass, Italian stone masonry, and advanced domotic automation.

title: Marea, Interiors by Missoni - Finca Cortesin, Casares, Costa del Sol, Spain
text: Marea by Missoni is an ultra-exclusive gated residential development by DarGlobal located within the prestigious Finca Cortesin 5-star golf resort in Casares, Spain. Overlooking the Mediterranean Sea and world-famous championship golf course (home to the Solheim Cup), Marea offers 2, 3, and 4-bedroom residences adorned with Missoni's signature zigzag patterns, vibrant color palettes, and premium natural stone. Amenities include private infinity pools, tennis and padel courts, wellness club, and direct access to Finca Cortesin Beach Club.

title: The Astwood - Heritage Boutique Residences in South Kensington, London
text: The Astwood is DarGlobal's distinguished prime central London development situated in South Kensington, Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. Combining historic Victorian stucco architecture with contemporary interior luxury, The Astwood offers a boutique collection of 1 to 3-bedroom residences and penthouses. The property is located within walking distance of Harrods, the Natural History Museum, Victoria and Albert Museum, Hyde Park, and prestigious international schools.

title: Sidra - Country Living and Vacation Villas in Sarajevo, Bosnia
text: Sidra is a master-planned vacation home and second-residence community situated in the picturesque hills surrounding Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina. Developed by DarGlobal, Sidra provides contemporary country villas with expansive private gardens, alpine-inspired architecture, clubhouse facilities, freshwater lakes, community parks, 24/7 gated security, and temperate summer climates, making it a popular mountain getaway for Middle Eastern and European investors.

title: DarGlobal Guide to International Investor Visas & Tax Advantages
text: DarGlobal properties are structured to maximize residency and tax efficiency. In the UAE, purchasing property above AED 2,000,000 grants an investor a 10-year Golden Visa with 0% personal income tax and 0% capital gains tax. In Oman, freehold buyers in AIDA secure permanent residency. In Spain, properties valued at €500,000+ qualify for the Golden Visa granting Schengen area travel privileges. All developments provide clear freehold title and rental management services.

title: About Wasalt (وصلت) - Saudi Arabia's Leading Proptech Real Estate Marketplace
text: Wasalt (وصلت) is the premier real estate marketplace and proptech platform in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Backed by Quara Holding and established in strategic partnership with Dar Al Arkan, Wasalt provides a verified, transparent, and technology-driven digital ecosystem for buying, selling, and leasing residential and commercial real estate across the Kingdom. Wasalt empowers Saudi citizens, expatriates, and foreign investors with comprehensive search tools, verified listing data, interactive masterplans, and certified brokerage connections in full alignment with Saudi Vision 2030.

title: REGA Licensing and Fal Brokerage Compliance on Wasalt
text: Wasalt operates in rigorous adherence to regulations set forth by the Real Estate General Authority (REGA / الهيئة العامة للعقار) of Saudi Arabia. Under Saudi law, every property listing published on Wasalt is required to display a valid Fal Brokerage and Marketing License (رخصة فال العقارية) and an official Advertising License number. Wasalt verifies advertiser credentials against government databases, eliminating duplicate or fraudulent listings and ensuring transparent real estate transactions across the Kingdom.

title: Ejar Tenancy Platform Integration on Wasalt
text: Wasalt integrates directly with Ejar (إيجار), the official digital rental network regulated by the Saudi Ministry of Municipal, Rural Affairs and Housing. Through Ejar integration, residential and commercial rental contracts facilitated via Wasalt can be registered and electronically signed using the unified standard lease agreement. This provides full legal enforceability through the Ministry of Justice execution courts and safeguards rights of both landlords and tenants.

title: Wasalt Business - Enterprise Solutions for Real Estate Developers and Brokers
text: Wasalt Business is the dedicated enterprise proptech portal designed for real estate developers, certified brokerage agencies, and individual Fal-licensed agents. It offers enterprise-grade CRM systems, lead pipeline management, MLS listing syndication, market analytics, and project marketing tools. Wasalt Business enables developers to market mega-projects and masterplans directly to thousands of pre-qualified buyers and institutional investors across Saudi Arabia and the GCC.

title: Wasalt Electronic Real Estate Auctions - Mazadat Wasalt
text: Wasalt Auctions (مزادات وصلت) is an accredited digital platform for conducting public, commercial, and judicial real estate auctions across Saudi Arabia. Verified by the Saudi judicial authorities, Wasalt Auctions provides transparent online bidding on prime residential and commercial land plots, multi-storey buildings, agricultural estates, and commercial towers. Participants authenticate through the national digital identity platform (Nafath/Absher) and submit bank-guaranteed deposits to bid in real-time.

title: Wasalt Real Estate Mortgage Calculator and Bank Financing
text: Wasalt provides an interactive digital mortgage calculator allowing property seekers to calculate monthly loan repayments, down payments, and maximum borrowing capacity. Wasalt partners with major Saudi commercial banks—including Al Rajhi Bank, Saudi National Bank (SNB), Riyad Bank, Bank Albilad, and Alinma Bank—to provide Sharia-compliant financing solutions (Murabaha and Ijara). Eligible Saudi citizens can also explore subsidized home financing under the Ministry of Housing's Sakani (سكني) program.

title: Foreign Real Estate Ownership and Premium Residency Rules in Saudi Arabia
text: Under Saudi Arabia's updated real estate regulations and the Premium Residency (الإقامة المميزة) law, foreign nationals and international investors are permitted to purchase and own real estate in designated residential, commercial, and industrial zones across the Kingdom. Holding real estate valued at SAR 4,000,000 or more can qualify international investors for the Saudi Real Estate Owner Premium Residency, granting long-term residency, family sponsorship, and business rights without requiring a Saudi sponsor.

title: Saudi Real Estate Transaction Tax (RETT) and Brokerage Fees on Wasalt
text: Real Estate Transaction Tax (RETT / ضريبة التصرفات العقارية) in Saudi Arabia is levied at a flat 5% on property sales, exempting eligible first-time Saudi homebuyers up to SAR 1,000,000 under government support programs. Standard real estate brokerage fees are legally capped at 2.5% of the total property transaction value under REGA regulations, payable upon contract signing.

title: Villas for Sale in Al Malqa, North Riyadh - Wasalt Real Estate Listings
text: Al Malqa is one of North Riyadh's most prestigious luxury neighborhoods, strategically situated along King Salman Road and Anas Ibn Malik Road near KAFD (King Abdullah Financial District). Wasalt listings in Al Malqa feature modern luxury villas: Plot sizes typically range from 350 sqm to 800 sqm, with sale prices ranging from SAR 4,000,000 to SAR 9,500,000. Common specifications: 5 master bedroom suites, private internal elevators, swimming pools, landscaped courtyards, maid and driver quarters, smart home automation, and 10-year building warranties under the Saudi Building Code.

title: Apartments for Sale in Al Narjis, North Riyadh - Wasalt
text: Al Narjis district in North Riyadh is an energetic, high-growth residential corridor positioned between Abu Bakr Al Siddiq Road and King Khalid International Airport. Wasalt lists contemporary 3-bedroom luxury apartments ranging from 120 sqm to 190 sqm, priced between SAR 850,000 and SAR 1,550,000. Key features include underground allocated parking, central air conditioning, rooftop terraces, children's play areas, smart access locks, and proximity to Princess Nourah University.

title: Executive Apartments for Rent in Al Olaya, Central Riyadh - Wasalt
text: Al Olaya serves as Riyadh's central business and commercial heart, home to Kingdom Centre, Al Faisaliah Tower, and premier multinational corporate offices. Wasalt listings offer furnished and unfurnished rental apartments: 1-bedroom executive studios and 2-3 bedroom residential flats. Annual lease prices range from SAR 55,000 to SAR 130,000, offering 24/7 security, dedicated gym facilities, covered parking, and immediate access to the Riyadh Metro line.

title: Luxury Designer Mansions and Villas for Sale in Hittin, Riyadh
text: Hittin is Riyadh's preeminent prime luxury neighborhood, directly adjacent to the historic Diriyah Gate development and Boulevard City. Wasalt highlights architectural designer mansions and standalone luxury villas in Hittin priced between SAR 6,500,000 and SAR 18,000,000 for 450 sqm to 1,200 sqm plots. Properties feature double-height entrance foyers, central internal courtyards, basement cinema and entertainment lounges, private Olympic-style swimming pools, imported Italian marble, and smart automated security.

title: Modern Residential Apartments for Sale and Rent in Al Yasmin, North Riyadh
text: Al Yasmin district is a highly favored residential neighborhood in North Riyadh, offering family-friendly living between Al Thumama Road and King Abdulaziz Road. Wasalt features modern duplexes and residential apartments: 3 to 4-bedroom apartments starting from SAR 920,000 for sale, and rental rates ranging between SAR 50,000 to SAR 80,000 annually. The neighborhood boasts comprehensive community parks, private schools, supermarkets, and rapid access to the Northern Ring Road.

title: Gated Compound Mansions and Villas in Al Nakheel, West Riyadh
text: Al Nakheel is a prime established district in West Riyadh situated close to King Saud University and Digital City. Wasalt showcases luxury compound villas with shared clubhouses, tennis courts, temperature-controlled pools, and private security gates. Villa purchase prices range from SAR 5,500,000 to SAR 15,000,000.

title: Sea-View Luxury Apartments for Sale in Al Shati, Jeddah Corniche
text: Al Shati is Jeddah's prime seafront residential district along the prestigious North Corniche, fronting the Red Sea. Wasalt listings in Al Shati highlight luxury high-rise waterfront apartments: 2, 3, and 4-bedroom units offering uninterrupted Red Sea sunsets, private health clubs, concierge services, temperature-controlled swimming pools, and private balcony terraces. Sale prices range from SAR 1,750,000 to SAR 4,800,000.

title: Waterfront Coastal Villas and Compounds in Obhur Al Shamaliyah, Jeddah
text: Obhur Al Shamaliyah (North Obhur) is Jeddah's capital for boating, water sports, and seaside living along the scenic Sharm Obhur inlet. Wasalt lists private waterfront villas and contemporary compound residences with private boat moorings, private beach access, and lush gardens. Prices start from SAR 2,300,000 for semi-detached townhomes up to SAR 12,000,000 for direct sea-front estates with private jetties.

title: Commercial Offices and Residential Apartments for Rent in Al Hamra, Jeddah
text: Al Hamra is an upscale coastal neighborhood celebrated for its diplomatic consulates, 5-star hotels, and immediate views of King Fahd's Fountain. Wasalt lists modern commercial corporate offices and executive residential apartments for lease, with annual rents between SAR 45,000 and SAR 110,000, providing convenient proximity to Palestine Street, Madinah Road, and the central Jeddah Corniche.

title: Luxury Villas for Sale in Al Hizam Al Thahabi and Corniche, Al Khobar
text: Al Khobar in the Eastern Province is Saudi Arabia's premier commercial hub for energy, engineering, and logistics, situated on the Arabian Gulf and connected to Bahrain via the King Fahd Causeway. Wasalt features executive standalone villas in Al Hizam Al Thahabi and Al Khobar Corniche priced from SAR 2,400,000 to SAR 6,200,000, offering expansive floorplans, private gardens, proximity to international schools, and coastal waterfront boulevards.

title: Residential and Investment Land Plots for Sale in Dammam - Wasalt
text: Wasalt lists certified residential, commercial, and industrial land plots across prime Dammam districts (such as Al Fursan, Al Shatea, and Al Noor). Land parcels range from 400 sqm for single-family villa construction up to 5,000+ sqm for multi-family residential towers or commercial plazas. All plots feature ready infrastructure (electricity, water, fiber-optic telecom) and official Sukuk title deeds verified through the Saudi Ministry of Justice.

title: DarGlobal and Wasalt: Strategic Relationship to Dar Al Arkan Ecosystem
text: Both DarGlobal and Wasalt originate from the visionary real estate ecosystem of Dar Al Arkan (Saudi Arabia's premier real estate development corporation). DarGlobal operates as the international luxury property developer listed on the London Stock Exchange, creating branded second homes and luxury urban towers across Dubai, London, Oman, Qatar, Spain, and Bosnia. Wasalt operates as the leading domestic Saudi proptech marketplace and brokerage platform, connecting verified property seekers, landlords, brokers, and developers across Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, and other Saudi cities in full compliance with REGA and Fal regulations.

title: Real Estate Investment in Makkah and Madinah - Wasalt
text: Under Saudi regulatory frameworks, real estate investment in the Holy Cities of Makkah and Madinah is subject to specialized long-term usufruct and development leasehold terms. Wasalt lists verified commercial hospitality plots, hotel developments, and residential towers in central Makkah (Al Aziziyah, Al Shouqiyyah) and Madinah (near the Prophet Mosque) suitable for institutional investors and Hajj/Umrah hospitality operators.

title: Commercial Real Estate: Offices and Retail Spaces on Wasalt
text: Wasalt Commercial provides dedicated listings for retail shops, commercial showrooms, corporate headquarter buildings, and Grade-A office spaces across Riyadh (KAFD, King Fahd Road, Al Olaya), Jeddah (Andalusia Road, Al Madinah Road), and Khobar. Listings include gross leasable area (GLA), civil defense licenses, parking ratios, and zoning permits.
